sources.entry: NetBox | Network source of truth for IPAM and data-centre infrastructure

summary.one_liner: netbox-docker is the community project that builds and packages NetBox (a network source of truth for IPAM and data-centre infrastructure) as Docker container images, run with Docker Compose.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the components needed to build NetBox as a container, and images are rebuilt regularly and pushed to Docker Hub, Quay.io and GitHub Container Registry. The Quickstart clones the release branch, copies an example docker-compose.override.yml, and runs docker compose pull and up to start the application. An admin user can be created with the Django manage.py createsuperuser command inside the netbox container, or via SUPERUSER_* environment variables. Images are tagged by NetBox version and netbox-docker version (for example vX.Y.Z-a.b.c), with latest and snapshot variants that track NetBox main. The README also provides a build.sh script for rebuilding the image and a test.sh script that runs NetBox's unit tests and checks that NetBox starts. Further guides (secrets, TLS, Kubernetes, monitoring, LDAP) are in the external wiki.
use_cases: track IP addresses and IPAM data in a container
build a custom NetBox container image
notable: Prebuilt images published to Docker Hub, Quay.io and GitHub Container Registry, rebuilt about every 24 hours
Image tags pair a NetBox version with a netbox-docker version for compatibility
Separate snapshot tags built from NetBox's main branch for prerelease testing
Admin user can be created automatically through SUPERUSER_* environment variables
caveats: The README says the project is currently maintained by the community, with no dedicated maintainer team named
Requires Docker 20.10.10 or newer, containerd 1.5.6 or newer, and docker-compose 1.28.0 or newer
The NetBox container image version must stay in sync with the version of the Git repository when updating
